Senior .net Developer

Permanent / Full Time
03.08.2026
1467101
1467101
Apply now
Senior C# Engineer, North Shore based role. Build high-scale Azure cloud services, use modern AI tools, and drive platform transformation.
Why You’d Like It
If you’re a Senior C# Developer who loves the challenge of high-scale systems and wants to genuinely leverage AI without sacrificing code quality, this one’s for you. You’ll be joining a market leader in the telematics and logistics tech space right as they hyper-scale their core cloud platform. Think real technical ownership, and an environment that actively encourages you to use modern AI tools to work smarter, not harder.

The Story
Our client is currently experiencing massive growth, signing major international agreements, and rapidly modernising their core technology stack. To support this momentum, they need a Senior Software Engineer to help drive the evolution of their platform, building fresh cloud services while refactoring legacy components to handle serious traffic volumes.

Company Profile
Based on Auckland's North Shore, this organisation is a household name in vehicle tracking, fleet management, and smart mobility solutions. They are a forward-thinking tech pioneer heavily invested in cloud hyper-scaling and aggressively adopting AI tools across their engineering practices. They offer a collaborative, product-driven culture with 4 days on-site, 1 day remote, with flexible working hours.

Your Role
As a Senior Software Engineer, you’ll take ownership of building, scaling, and running resilient cloud services while mentoring intermediate devs along the way. You will balance modern microservices architecture with existing systems, ensuring performance, security, and top-tier code quality.
  • Design, write, and deploy clean, performant C# (.net) code across microservices and REST APIs.
  • Architect and run cloud-native services (preferably in Azure) designed for high reliability and scale.
  • Pragmatically integrate AI tools (like GitHub Copilot) into your daily workflow, knowing when to leverage them and when to fix their mistakes.
  • Work comfortably across diverse databases, including MongoDB, PostgreSQL, and SQL Server.
  • Drive automated testing, robust CI/CD practices, and mentor junior and intermediate team members.
Benefits
  • Competitive Compensation: Competitive base salary - dependent on experience.
  • Modern Tooling: Full backing and freedom to use modern AI coding tools to boost productivity.
  • Career Progression: Clear, rapid growth pathways tied directly to the company's aggressive expansion.
  • Great Culture: A supportive, low-ego team that values high standards and open communication.
Your Fit
You’re an experienced C# Engineer with a proven track record of shipping production cloud applications. You take genuine pride in what you write, hold quality high under pressure, and have a healthy skepticism toward AI-generated code, you use it to speed up, but you never blindly trust it. You're comfortable navigating both modern microservices and legacy monoliths, and you enjoy sharing your knowledge to lift the team around you.
